name: Readwise
description: Send a note to Readwise Reader, and pull your Readwise and Reader highlights back: onto the note they came from, at the passage, or onto a readwise board.

board.description: The outline other highlights land in (default readwise)

page.description: The page in the board outline they land under (default readwise)

link.description: The URL a sent note gets in Reader, with {outline}, {machine} and {id} (default https://ep0ch.invalid/{outline}@{machine}/b/{id})

machine.description: This machine's name in ep0ch:// links (default the host name)

tags.description: Tags a sent document gets in Reader (default ["ep0ch"])

api.description: Readwise's address (default https://readwise.io); a test points it at a fake

minutes.description: How long one pull may work before it stops and leaves the rest for the next (default 4)

actions.label: Send to Reader
actions.description: Saves the note (and the notes under it) to Readwise Reader as a document that links back here

actions.label: Pull Readwise highlights
actions.description: Fetches highlights changed since the last pull: one on a note you sent becomes an annotation at its passage; the rest land on the readwise board
